props.heading: Small batches. Teachers who stay.
props.sub: Structured coaching for board exams and competitive entrance, in batches capped at 25 — so no student sits at the back and disappears.

props.label: About Us
props.heading: About Our Institute
props.body:
We started with two classrooms and a simple rule: a batch stops at 25 students, whatever the demand.

That cap is the whole model. It means a teacher knows which students are struggling without waiting for a test to tell them, and doubts get cleared in the room rather than in a queue afterwards.

Our faculty are full-time and stay with a batch through the year, so nobody has to re-explain themselves to a new teacher in February.

pillars.title: Batches capped at 25
pillars.text: Firmly. We open a new batch rather than add a 26th chair.

items.q: When do admissions open, and is there an entrance test?
items.a: Admissions for the new academic year open in March. There is a short written assessment for entrance-prep batches — it decides which batch suits the student, not whether they get in.
Twenty-five students, capped. If a batch fills we open another rather than add seats, which is why some slots close early.

items.q: Can fees be paid in instalments?
items.a: Yes. Fees are quoted per academic year and can be split into two or three instalments at no extra charge. Ask at the front desk for the schedule.
Weekday batches run after school hours and weekend batches run in the morning. Doubt-clearing sessions are on Sundays and are open to every enrolled student.
Yes — printed modules, past papers and weekly test papers are included in the fee. Nothing further needs to be bought from us.

items.q: What if my child joins mid-year?
items.a: Mid-year joining is possible where a seat exists. We arrange catch-up sessions for the modules already covered before the student sits their first weekly test.

props.heading: Come and sit in on a class

notes: `sections` are inserted in order when a new coaching site is created; `content` layers ready-made copy and photos over each section's manifest defaults so the starter site is demo-ready. This replaces the old `copy` block, which nothing ever read. Faculty are listed WITHOUT photographs — the Team section falls back to a clean initial avatar — so no stock-photo face is captioned with an invented name and qualification; the institute should add its own. Stats are deliberately institutional facts (years running, batch size, faculty count) rather than selection or rank counts: a demo should not hand an institute unverifiable results claims it might publish as-is. Photos are hosted Unsplash URLs (SiteRenderer::media passes any http(s) URL through) — replace them with the institute's own before going live.
